name: DWH Expose Binding Contract
kind: port binding and external/local surface model
purpose: define Expose as the set of surfaces/targets to which canonical ports can be bound without creating parallel semantic authority

concepts.port: canonical bind point/interface owned by the relevant semantic/runtime capability
concepts.expose: binding that makes a port usable through a concrete surface or target
concepts.implementation: runtime code that realizes the binding; implementation language is orthogonal to Expose type

examples.meaning: the #SITE semantic resource may resolve through a filesystem Expose binding

rules: REST and WebSocket are Expose surfaces, not implementation languages
PHP and Python may implement the same Expose semantics
one port may have multiple Expose bindings
Expose does not own the semantic source behind the port
Expose existence does not grant authorization
DWH may resolve where a symbol/port is bound without becoming the execution runtime
a binding target may be a physical path such as /home/www
binding/projection must not silently create a second canonical source of truth
